script:
Jiang Zhong
You are the young master of the local Jiang Group, with another identity as a backbone member of the patriotic youth organization in the three northeastern provinces.
Your family has always been the largest consortium in the three northeastern provinces. The industries and multiple transportation routes accumulated since your grandfather's generation have given you solid, unmatched foundations in Northeast China. However, after the fall of Northeast China in 1931, many merchant associations quickly showed allegiance to the Japanese to preserve their businesses. You strongly urged your father not to collaborate with them and secretly joined the patriotic youth organization at your school. Despite heavy pressure from the Japanese, the Jiang Group managed to survive on its substantial foundation and years of reputation.
However, in 1932, a merchant association surnamed Hai suddenly rose to prominence, overnight surpassing Jiang Group to become the largest merchant association in the three northeastern provinces. With Japanese help, the Hai Group seized many of your family's transportation routes, putting you in a difficult position. You and your father watched anxiously as the ancestral property might be destroyed in your hands, feeling desperate but unable to think of countermeasures.
Last year at a youth organization meeting, you received intelligence that Hai Bei, president of the Hai merchant association, had suddenly become wealthy by doing business with the Japanese, and had been using your family's seized transportation routes to transport military supplies for the Japanese. You and your classmates in the organization felt deep sorrow thinking of compatriots suffering from war and family destruction, and your hatred for Hai Bei grew daily.
Early this year, looking at last year's severely loss-making accounts, your father once again proposed cooperating with the Japanese. This time, no matter how you tried to persuade him, your father wouldn't listen. He told you that even if it meant being a traitor, he couldn't let the family business built by previous generations be destroyed. After that, your father began taking you to the Peace Hotel, bowing and scraping to the Japanese like other businessmen. The Jiang Group gradually got some breathing room. You watched your father's flattering smile with disgust, secretly vowing to rescue the Jiang family from this predicament.
Gradually, you conceived an idea: if Hai Bei died, with your father's prestige, you could definitely reclaim the original properties. Since Hai Bei had no children, the Hai merchant association would have no heir and pose no threat. Then persuading your father to stop cooperating with the Japanese might be possible. After careful consideration, you told your father your idea, and he, harboring resentment over Hai Bei's oppression, agreed to your plan. He gave you contact information for an assassin called Old K, asking you to hire him to kill Hai Bei.
You went to find Old K according to your father's contact address, but discovered he had quietly left Northeast China. You decided to act yourself. From intelligence previously provided by the youth organization, you learned that Hai Bei stayed at the Peace Hotel every fourth to sixth of each month with only his second concubine. You felt that place, with many people and lax security, was a perfect opportunity to act. At the next organization meeting, you proposed assassinating Hai Bei, hiding your family vendetta and only saying you wanted to kill this traitor who transported military supplies for the Japanese. Your proposal received unanimous support from organization members, who decided you would carry out this assassination mission. Through organization intelligence personnel, you obtained detailed information about the Peace Hotel, learned that Hai Bei had a long-term reservation for room 1203, and even got keys to the staff changing room. You finally planned to disguise yourself as a hotel cleaner and wait for an opportunity to kill Hai Bei.
[October 4th]
At 8:00 PM, you arrived at the Peace Hotel. Your identity as the Jiang family's young master aroused no suspicion. You snuck into the staff changing room, stole a cleaner's uniform and changed into it, then pushed a cleaning cart to the twelfth floor to wait for an opportunity.
Just before 9:00 PM, you saw a beautiful woman (Bai Xiaomei) come out of Hai Bei's room, followed by a young man from the adjacent room 1202. They went downstairs one after the other. You thought Hai Bei might be alone in his room now.
At 9:05 PM, you came to the door of room 1203, knocked and said you needed to clean the room, preparing to shoot Hai Bei with your gun when he opened the door. But you heard movement from the adjacent room 1204, and after thinking about it, decided not to shoot.
After a while, Hai Bei opened the door and let you in. Once inside, Hai Bei told you to only clean the living room as he was going to rest in the bedroom. You saw an untouched fruit plate on the table with a fruit knife beside it, and had an idea. You casually tidied up the fruit plate, hiding the fruit knife behind you, then knocked on the bedroom door asking Hai Bei if the things on the table needed cleaning. When Hai Bei opened the door, you caught him off guard and stabbed the knife into his heart. You watched Hai Bei slowly stop convulsing, thinking of the relieved expression your father would show, and all tension and pressure vanished. A slight smile even appeared at the corner of your mouth. You pulled out the fruit knife, wiped the blood clean with tissues, then threw the fruit knife into the cleaning cart.
At 9:10 PM, you pushed the cleaning cart out of room 1203, threw the bloody tissues into the trash can beside the elevator. Then you went to the changing room to change clothes, but when you felt in your pocket, you discovered the patriotic youth organization's identifying item you carried was missing. You thought it might have fallen in 1203, and if discovered, it would be terrible. So you continued wearing the service uniform and pushed the cleaning cart back to the 12th floor.
At 9:20 PM, you reached the door of 1203. The identifying item was lying right at the doorway - it must have fallen out earlier. As you bent down to pick it up, the door to 1203 opened, startling you greatly. Looking closely, it was a service staff from the downstairs café coming out of the room. He looked very panicked - you knew he had seen the body. But he stammered, saying it wasn't convenient inside and couldn't go in. You didn't care what he had done, just wanted to get away quickly. But you were stopped by an unimportant guest from room 1210 who wanted you to clean his room. Feeling guilty, you didn't dare refuse and could only go clean.
At 9:50 PM, you finally finished cleaning and prepared to go back again, but before you could reach there, you heard a scream...
acts_goal:
You are the killer - good luck! Here's a killer tip: when others question you about items in the cleaning cart, say "The cleaning cart isn't used by just me alone," hehe.
Try to hide your patriotic youth identity.
